message.content: {"note_claim": "The 93 million visits figure refers to the larger aggregator website (not the Telegram group itself) that linked to the group.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "The website, which had around 62 million visits in February alone and whose core audience is in the United States, describes itself as a “moral free file host where anything legal is hosted forever.”", "reason": "The page confirms the Zzz group was linked from the Motherless aggregator site and gives visit figures for that site (62 million in February), but does not state 93 million, so it only indirectly supports the note's distinction."}

parsed.note_claim: The 93 million visits figure refers to the larger aggregator website (not the Telegram group itself) that linked to the group.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: The website, which had around 62 million visits in February alone and whose core audience is in the United States, describes itself as a “moral free file host where anything legal is hosted forever.”
parsed.reason: The page confirms the Zzz group was linked from the Motherless aggregator site and gives visit figures for that site (62 million in February), but does not state 93 million, so it only indirectly supports the note's distinction.
